reason: The cited evidence shows that Al+Ti additions to Ni-Co-Fe-based FCC HEAs form coherent γ′ precipitates and that precipitation hardening dominates, but none of the cited studies involve Ti and Ni as primary constituents; the extrapolation to a Ti-Ni-primary HEA matrix is unsupported by the evidence provided.
premises: Al addition to an FCC HEA can promote γ′ precipitate formation
γ′ precipitates in FCC HEAs are coherent and provide precipitation hardening
Precipitation hardening from γ′ is much greater than solid solution strengthening
DED processing is suitable for producing γ+γ′ microstructures in HEAs
The proposed Ti-Ni primary HEA will form a single-phase FCC matrix amenable to γ′ precipitation
